sources.title: Aya Vision 8B model card
sources.evidence: Exact model card identifies the developer, open-weight research release, 23-language coverage, 16K context, text/image inputs, text output, license, and Command R7B-derived language model with SigLIP2 vision encoder. Reopened October 27, 2026: the card still advertises the nominal 8B size and explicitly identifies a Command R7B-based language model further post-trained with the Aya Expanse recipe. It does not state a separate active-parameter count.

sources.title: Aya Vision: Expanding the worlds AI can see
sources.evidence: Dated March 4, 2025. The article's embedded body explicitly announces the 8B and 32B open-weight models as available that day; the visible extracted page omits most of that body, so the page HTML was also inspected.

sources.title: Aya Vision: Advancing the Frontier of Multilingual Multimodality
sources.evidence: Section 4 describes late fusion of a SigLIP2 encoder, a two-layer SwiGLU connector, and the Command R7B-derived LLM. Table 6 separately gives the 8B variant's LLM as 8B, vision encoder as 400M, and connector as 190M, with 32 LLM layers and grouped-query attention. Independently rechecked the full report freshly fetched October 27, including Section 4, Table 6 and the comparison tables. The rounded components sum to 8.59B, retained as approximately 8.6B complete parameters. Neither full-model nor language-only active parameters are defined.

sources.title: CC-BY-NC 4.0 License with Acceptable Use Addendum
sources.evidence: The license linked by the exact model card is Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 with Cohere's Acceptable Use Addendum.

sources.title: Aya Vision 8B checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Direct unauthenticated request returned HTTP 401: model access is restricted and authentication/access approval is required.

sources.evidence: Direct unauthenticated request returned HTTP 401. Tensor identities, shapes, buffers and tied weights could not be checked.

sources.title: Aya Vision 8B public repository metadata
sources.publisher: Hugging Face metadata for Cohere Labs repository
sources.evidence: Public API reports automatic gating, AyaVisionForConditionalGeneration, and an aggregate 8,631,842,032 F16 safetensors elements. It exposes the default text/image chat template. Aggregate storage metadata alone does not establish an exact learned-parameter total. Fresh October 27 metadata at revision d7601ac8fd3baf6f59c5fc9514c618ef0f24268f reports the same 8,631,842,032 F16 total, corroborating the approximate complete size without establishing an active count.

sources.title: An Overview of Cohere's Models
sources.evidence: Exact c4ai-aya-vision-8b row lists 16k context, text/image modality and retirement on April 4, 2026. Aya is identified as a multilingual model family.

sources.title: Command R7B December 2024 model card
sources.evidence: The exact language-model ancestor named by Aya Vision's authors is an autoregressive Transformer with alternating sliding-window and global attention. Used only to corroborate architectural lineage, not to transfer its counts, context or capabilities. Reopened October 27: the base card advertises nominal 7B parameters but provides no separately defined active count; the Aya report gives its own modified language component as 8B.

sources.title: Reasoning Capabilities
sources.evidence: Defines dedicated reasoning through thinking content blocks and controls. Does not establish an exact Aya Vision 8B support or exclusion claim.

sources.title: Basic usage of tool use (function calling)
sources.evidence: Describes function calling for the Command family, without an explicit Aya Vision 8B support or exclusion statement.

sources.title: Aya Expanse: Combining Research Breakthroughs for a New Multilingual Frontier
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the complete report from the fresh October 27 primary-source cache. It describes the post-training recipe referenced by Aya Vision but provides no active-count convention for Aya Vision or its R7B-derived backbone. The explicit 39B active count belongs to the Mixtral comparator.

sources.title: Tiny Aya: Bridging Scale and Multilingual Depth
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the full later report from the fresh October 27 cache. Its parameter table distinguishes Tiny Aya embedding, non-embedding and total counts; it provides no Aya Vision 8B active count, and its 2.8B non-embedding figure is not a transferable active-count convention.

sources.title: Command A: An Enterprise-Ready Large Language Model
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the full report from the fresh October 27 cache, including comparison headings and Command R7B rows. It provides benchmark comparisons but no separate active-parameter count for Aya Vision 8B or its R7B language ancestor.

sources.title: Command R7B Arabic: A Small but Mighty Arabic LLM
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the full report from the fresh October 27 cache for R7B parameter definitions and comparisons. It provides no applicable active-count disclosure for Aya Vision 8B or its named language ancestor.

sources.title: Introducing Command A+: Making sovereign agentic capabilities available to all
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The May 2026 page explicitly distinguishes 218B total and 25B active for Command A+; the family comparison table covers Command A variants and gives no Aya Vision 8B or R7B active count. A separate model's MoE figures are not transferred.

sources.title: Command R7B model directory entry
sources.evidence: Fresh active-count search surfaced a 7B-active claim for the R7B ancestor. The web reader failed, then direct retrieval of the full HTML succeeded. Its sole Official source link is Cohere's generic model list, with no separate field-level count derivation. The referenced primary list does not state an activated-parameter convention. This uncorroborated directory claim does not establish an Aya Vision count; the Aya paper separately gives its language component as 8B.

developer.note: Cohere Labs is Cohere's research group.

family.note: Normalized name for the explicitly identified Aya Vision model family.

release_date.note: Dated first-party launch announces the 8B variant as available that day.

open_weights.note: Released weights require acceptance of the repository's access conditions.

license.note: License shorthand; the linked terms also impose Cohere's Acceptable Use Addendum.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 checks retain approximately 8.6B complete multimodal parameters from the developer report's rounded 8B language model, 0.4B vision encoder and 0.19B connector. The sum includes the learned encoder despite freezing during multimodal training. Hub metadata corroborates the scale; the published component counts support this approximate total without a tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-model and ancestry searches plus original and later first-party reports found no separate complete-model or language-only active count. Dense architecture and rounded component totals do not define activation across image encoding and text decoding. The appz R7B 7B-active lead has no supporting developer count convention and is not transferred to Aya's separately specified 8B language component.

architecture.note: Dense Transformer language backbone with GQA and SwiGLU, connected to SigLIP2 by an MLP; derived from the documented component architecture and named Transformer ancestor.

context_window.note: Preserves nominal 16K/16k as 16,000 under the catalog convention. Exact configuration limit was inaccessible; this is the documented context specification.

reasoning.note: The default template encourages step-by-step answers, but that does not establish dedicated thinking-mode support. No exact support or exclusion statement was verified, so the baseline false is cleared.

tool_call.note: The exposed default template has no tool serialization; general Command documentation is not an exact Aya Vision exclusion. Native function-calling support remains unverified and baseline false is cleared.

description.value: Multilingual vision-language model for OCR, image captioning and visual question answering across 23 languages.
description.note: Uses the developer's documented tasks and language coverage without comparative claims.

patch.description: Multilingual vision-language model for OCR, image captioning and visual question answering across 23 languages.
patch.notes: Approximately 8.6B complete parameters from the developer report's rounded components: 8B language model, 0.4B vision encoder and 0.19B connector. Active parameters are not separately disclosed. CC-BY-NC-4.0 includes Cohere's Acceptable Use Addendum. The Cohere API identifier was retired April 4, 2026.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retained the approximate 8.6B complete multimodal total and component breakdown. Reopened the exact model card, metadata and R7B ancestor; performed fresh count searches and inspected original and later Cohere reports and comparisons. No supported complete-model or language-only active count was found. Recorded the uncorroborated third-party R7B active-count lead, kept active explicitly null and preserved unrelated assessments. No weight shards were requested.
